name: pico-xr

plugins.name: pico-spatial-agentic-tools
plugins.description: Project Skills for PICO Spatial SDK development. Shared MCP services and Hooks are provided by the user-level general plugin. Helps AI agents assist with Spatial ECS, scene/anchor workflows, device debugging, performance/profiler analysis, emulator and project setup, SDK migration compatibility checks, and PICO CLI device workflows.

plugins.name: pico-unity-agentic-tools
plugins.description: Project Skills and sub-agents for PICO Unity development. Shared MCP services and Hooks are provided by the user-level general plugin. Helps AI agents assist with Unity PICO Spatial setup, Spatial Adapter runtime APIs, PICO XR building blocks, Unity OpenXR setup, the Unity Hub CLI, device debugging, build and deployment workflows, and PICO CLI device workflows.

plugins.name: pico-general-agentic-tools
plugins.description: Entry plugin for PICO development, installed once per user. Configures the PICO Spatial or Unity platform plugin into each project, and provides the PICO development knowledge MCP, knowledge-graph querying, and PICO CLI usage guidance.

description: PICO development plugins: user-level general provides shared MCP services and Hooks; Spatial and Unity plugins provide project Skills.
